title: Xdrip+ with Blucon Nightrider on Full-Android-Smartwatch (No.1 D6, Android 5.1): Bluetooth issue
body:
I installed Xdrip+ on a smartwatch with normal Android 5.1 (No.1 D6).
I first had a lot of problems connecting Xdrip+ to the Blucon Nightrider, I got many times the error "Invalid PIN", though the PIN definitely was entered correctly.
I had the same problem also on a smartphone (Elephone P8000) with Android 5.1.
Somehow finally I got the connection to the Nightrider. All works fine, until the Nightrider leaves the Bluetooth range of the watch.
When in range again, sometimes XDrip+ reconnects to the Blucon, but very often it doesn't. Even after 30min and switching Bluetooth off and on and doing "Restart Collector" there is no reconnection. Rebooting the watch and/or switching the Blucon off and on normally make the system working again.
On a tablet with Android 7.0 XDrip+ always reconnects within 1-3mins normally without any further action.
Is there an issue with Android 5.1/Bluetooth?
I'm very interested to get this smartwatch working, as it would make it easier to carry it as a master than it is with the tablet.

@masipmarch Possibly you are right with your hint, that Android 5.1 may cause the problem. I tried also to connect a smartphone with Android 5.1 to the Blucon via xDrip+. It failed with "invalid PIN" while trying to connect to the Blucon, but it is possible, that this error came, because I didn't remove the Blucon before from the normally used tablet, I just switched the tablet off. So I am not sure, if the error was really Android 5.1 related.
I close this issue, as xDrip+ is working fine on Ourtime X01 Air, Finow Q1 Pro, Finow M9 and Microwear H5. So it seems to be a problem just with the No.1 D6, which needn't be analyzed any further.
